# Kael

Lean build, early 30s. Dark brown skin, silver-white dreadlocks pulled back. Amber eyes. Always wears a weathered brown leather jacket with brass buckles. Carries a satchel covered in patches. Has a thin scar across the bridge of his nose.

## Style notes
Slightly stylized realism, warm color palette, visible brushstrokes.
